verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms browser-based rendering with WebGL (community mention of 'rendering on both Canvas and WebGL') and easy npm/CDN distribution suggesting reasonable payload, but there is no mention anywhere in the pack of WebGPU support, a WebGPU renderer, or a roadmap toward it. missing for 10: explicit WebGPU renderer/roadmap documentation, payload-size benchmarks, and independent corroboration of WebGL performance beyond one anecdotal comment.
